Given origin/main at the build under test

When Search apps/web (src, convex, prompts) for status inference from text: classifyEncounterType, legacyInferEncounterType, encounter/encounter-type.md, encTypeSource writes, regexes over 'admission'/'consult'

Then No code reads the status out of dictation or photo text, whether or not anything calls it
